flow.description: Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

finding.description: Injection path 0: user input concatenated into SQL.
finding.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

proof_by_construction.trigger: GET /items?id=' OR 1=1-- reaches the concatenated query.
preconditions: The endpoint is reachable by an unauthenticated caller.
proof_by_construction.missing_or_inadequate_control: No parameterized query or escaping on the SQL path.
proof_by_construction.expected_impact: Arbitrary SQL executes against the application database.
